t: The Brenner Drain Unblocker Ltr is a liquid clearing agent designed to remove stubborn blockages from pipes and waste outlets. This liquid acts quickly to dissolve grease, hair, and everyday organic debris in sinks, baths, basins, and showers. Ideal for busy plumbers and facility maintenance teams working in commercial kitchens and domestic bathrooms, the non-acidic formulation clears slow-running pipework without damaging plastic plumbing or metal fixtures. This 1 Ltr bottle provides a reliable solution for routine drain maintenance and emergency callouts.
b: Breaks Down Grease, Hair & Debris Fast
